rule_text:
Prototype 1 encodes REM (100% pure) primarily through EOG (50%), with EEG (45%) and EMG (5%) contribution.
Its EEG signature shows elevated β_h (+6.4 dB, sensitivity=2.9) and suppressed δ (-11.1 dB, sensitivity=1.3).
The β_h activity is present in 100% of each epoch (sustained), with quiescent eye movements (REM 0% active) and intermediate muscle tone.
This is conflicting with REM physiology: missing: EMG atonic, θ elevated. Note: model primarily uses β_h, atypical for REM.
